title.narrative: Adaptive and Productive Social Safety Net Project

description.narrative: The development objective of the Central African Republic - Adaptive and Productive Social Safety Nets Project is to (a) expand access to social safety nets for poor and vulnerable households in targeted areas and (b) strengthen the shock-responsiveness of delivery systems. The project will consist of the following components: Component 1: Expansion of social safety nets to households in targeted areas (US$22.4 million equivalent); Component 2: Social safety nets systems strengthening to respond to climate-related and other shocks (US$5.1 million equivalent); Component 3: Project management, monitoring and evaluation (US$2.5 million equivalent); and Component 4: Contingent Emergency Response Component (CERC, US$0 million).
The objectives of the Project are to strengthen safety nets and skills programs to improve resilience among the poor and vulnerablepopulation.
